newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani rupee ends steady in kerb, seen stable.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani rupee ends steady in kerb, seen stable.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee ended unchanged at 41 to the dollar on Tuesday as dollar demand eased. Dealers said the rupee would be stable in the near term.

"Dollar demand was low because local players have been hit by a liquidity crunch. The rupee has stabilised in recent weeks after the government announced there would not be any devaluation," one dealer said.

The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on October 22, was 40.1200/ 40.3206 to the dollar. The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates ended at 2.35 percent up from 2.30 percent on Monday. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
